title: A useful learning loop connects failures to reviewed changes
text: The supplied YC example describes a data-query agent and the use of failed attempts to improve its future operation. The key pattern is the return path from a real task to a checked correction—not the assumption that recording usage automatically teaches the system what was right.
qualification: First-party example in edited notes; performance improvements and verification quality were not independently checked.
